defect: An event in the last 64 Ethereum blocks of 2023 would require a 2024 block timestamp to evaluate the preregistered 64-block availability stress, violating the official 2024+ source seal.
correction: The authoritative source eligibility ends 64 blocks before the first block at or after 2024-01-01 00:00 UTC. Therefore every included event has both 12-block primary and 64-block stress confirmation available strictly before 2024. No 2024 block, price, label or outcome may be requested.
impact: Only the final approximately 13 minutes of 2023 Ethereum events are source-ineligible; every earlier 2021-2023 month and all scientific/model/economic rules are unchanged.
